description: Source code for LinearLayoutResizeOperation class, handling resize operations for Android LinearLayouts in the Android Studio UI designer, including weight management and layout adjustments.

classes.name: LinearLayoutResizeOperation
classes.description: Handles resize operations for Android LinearLayouts, managing weights and layout adjustments during UI design.

classes.name: LinearResizeContext
classes.description: Custom resize state class used during linear layout resizing, managing weight calculations and unweighted sizes.

methods.name: isVertical
methods.description: Checks if a given RadViewComponent layout is vertical based on its orientation attribute.

methods.name: updateResizeContext
methods.description: Updates resize context, computing layout weights and handling wrap_content or match_parent boundaries.

methods.name: onResizeUpdate
methods.description: Updates resize state during a resize operation, matching bounds to wrap or fill segments.

methods.name: setNewSizeBounds
methods.description: Sets new size bounds for a node, affecting layout_weight or default pixel sizing.

methods.name: getResizeUpdateMessage
methods.description: Generates a message describing the resize operation, including weight adjustments.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the layout weight of a child view in a LinearLayout.

methods.name: getWeightSum
methods.description: Calculates the total weight sum of children in a LinearLayout.

methods.name: getSumOfWeights
methods.description: Sums the weights of all children in a LinearLayout.

methods.name: createResizeContext
methods.description: Creates a new LinearResizeContext for managing resize state.
